# Vaia

> > Vaia provides curated student and pupil discounts from top brands including Spotify, Amazon Music, Swarovski, and more.

Vaia (operated by StudySmarter GmbH) offers a comprehensive discount directory helping students and pupils save money on popular brands and services across categories like streaming, travel, fitness, and lifestyle.

- Student discounts
- Pupil savings
- Brand deals
- Spotify student offers
- Amazon Music discounts
- Swarovski student deals
- Flixbus travel savings

- Emma mattress deals
- Turbopass attractions
- Sallie Mae financial services
- Discount directory
- StudySmarter GmbH
